hosting.//: Do not add **/*.txt here. It looks like it only drops Next's RSC payloads (__next.*.txt, index.txt) but it also drops robots.txt, and it would silently break client-side prefetch if a second route is ever added.

headers.//: MUST stay first. cleanUrls serves pages at directory URLs (/, /404/), which a **/*.html glob does not match — without this baseline the homepage silently falls through to Firebase's max-age=3600 default. Firebase applies every matching rule and the LAST wins per header key, so the asset rules below override only Cache-Control.
Content-hashed by the Next build — safe to pin forever.
Filenames carry the source asset's uuid, so they change when the font does.
